name: David Kim
title: Licensed Real Estate Salesperson
bio: David brings a finance background to real estate, which means he thinks about every deal through the lens of long-term value — not just curb appeal. He focuses on Midtown and the high-density corridors of Manhattan, serving both corporate relocations and individual buyers navigating the condo market. His analytical approach and calm demeanor make complex transactions feel manageable.

testimonials.quote: David walked me through the financial side of every apartment we saw. Not just price — carrying costs, board fees, resale history. That level of detail gave me total confidence in our offer.
testimonials.author: Priya N.

testimonials.quote: We were relocating from Seoul with two weeks to find a place. David had everything organized and closed our rental before we even landed. Exceptional.
testimonials.author: Ji-won & Min L.
